watches.name: Seaborne Osprey | VK64 Chronograph | Beachcomber Edition
watches.description: Seaborne Osprey USA Built Chronograph Beachcomber Yellow The NEW USA Designed, Built & Tested Models of our Classic Chronograph Osprey ONLY available in USA - email us if you are elsewhere The Beachcomber Edition Seaborne Osprey is a stand-out -- in every possible way! With our Osprey's we've taken the "standard" chronograph and spiced it up with Seaborne's signature use of color -- creating a timepiece that is cool, fun, and stands out from the crowd of watches that look like everything else. Our Beachcomber Edition colorway, with bright yellow dial and accents of blue, purple and pink are standouts that catch the eye and carry the conversation. The Beachcomber is a great choice for your Summer watch or chasing the Winter blues away. Why settle for the every day watch, when you can have the colorful and cool Seaborne Osprey Beachcomber Edition? We love the feel of mechanical watches and the engineering that goes into them. But sometimes it's great to grab your watch and run out for adventure -- without worrying about setting it. You can have the feel of both with hybrid movements such as our VK64 Mecaquartz movement. It offers the look, feel and action of a mechanical chronograph but at a fraction of the cost. When the Osprey chronograph pusher is engaged, the sweeping second hand and instant snap back action is a joy to see. It's amazing technology that works extremely well, and is built with exceptional quality. The Seaborne Osprey comes equipped with a genuine leather "alligator look" quick release Seaborne strap. Now USA Built & Tested! Movement: VK64 mecaquartz. Quartz caliber incorporates gear architecture for smooth second hand sweep. • Case Material: 316L Marine Grade Stainless Steel • Case Width: 40 mm • Lug Width (Strap Size): 20 mm • Case Thickness: 12 mm • Lug to Lug: 47 mm • Crown Diameter: 5.7 mm • Dial Lume: BGW9 (blue) Indices and C3 (green) hands • Crystal: Sapphire w/AR coating • Water Resistance: 100 Meters / 10 ATM • Crown: Signed, Screw Down

watches.name: Runabout Harborside – 36mm Unisex Field & Sports Watch
watches.description: Inspired by the gleaming white hulls and bright summer spirit of classic runabouts, the Runabout Harborside is pure everyday escape. Some watches are built for expeditions. The Runabout is built for real life. Coffee run? Yep. Weekend getaway? Obviously. Dinner by the marina? Absolutely. Monday meetings where you'd rather be somewhere near water? Especially that. Inspired by the classic runabouts of the mid-century—the kind of small boats that made summer feel glamorous—the Seaborne Runabout captures that same spirit in watch form: colorful, confident, easygoing, and always ready to go. No fuss. No drama. No “special occasion only” nonsense. Just a ridiculously wearable everyday watch with serious personality. At 36mm, the Runabout hits that sweet spot: vintage-inspired proportions that look equally fantastic on just about anyone. Big enough to make a statement. Compact enough to stay comfortable all day. And because not every great watch needs to be a mechanical science project, we powered it with the super reliable Japanese Miyota GM12 quartz movement. Grab it. Set it. Go live your life. BUILT FOR WHATEVER YOUR DAY BECOMES The Runabout is what happens when classic style and carefree practicality get together over dock drinks. It’s sporty without trying too hard. Polished without being precious. Colorful without screaming for attention. This is your “one more watch” watch. The one you throw on for: beach weekends city wandering brunch that turns into cocktails summer weddings airport runs random Tuesday confidence boosts Basically? Anywhere. The Runabout is our take on the classic sports watch: a mid-sized, 36mm unisex field watch built around the “Go Anywhere, Do Anything” (GADA) idea. Harborside pairs a crisp white dial with bright blue 3-6-9 numerals and orange accents, sapphire crystal and 100M water resistance—equally at home on the water, at work, or out for dinner. Sized for both men and women, Runabout blends the practicality of a traditional field watch with the polished character of an everyday sports watch. Don’t let the good looks get in the way of a good time—in true Seaborne fashion, it’s ready for adventure. QUICK SPECS 36mm stainless steel case 43mm Lug to Lug 9.75mm case thickness 6.5mm crown diameter Sapphire crystal Japanese Miyota GM12 quartz movement 100M water resistance Designed for everyday wear Comfortable, versatile proportions Colorful Seaborne styling Unisex design Multiple 20mm quick release straps available FAQ: Is the Runabout Harborside a men's or women's watch? Runabout is a 36mm unisex sports watch designed to work across a wide range of wrist sizes. Its proportions feel classic on a men's wrist and sporty on many women's wrists. Is the Runabout a field watch? Yes. Runabout is Seaborne's colorful take on the classic field watch , combining a legible 3-6-9 dial, everyday durability and grab-and-go quartz reliability with a more polished coastal personality. What does GADA mean? GADA means “Go Anywhere, Do Anything.” Runabout was designed to move easily from casual weekends to work, travel, dinner and everyday adventure

watches.name: WaveCatcher Blue Lagoon – 38mm Automatic Surf GMT Watch
watches.description: WaveCatcher Blue Lagoon – 38mm Automatic Surf GMT Watch The Seaborne WaveCatcher Blue Lagoon is a 38mm automatic surf GMT watch inspired by the colorful surfboards and carefree beach culture of the 1960s and ’70s. Powered by the Seiko TMI NH34 automatic GMT movement, it pairs a bright coastal dial with a custom GMT bezel marking famous surf breaks around the world—including Pipeline, Cloudbreak, Maverick’s, Supertubes and Montañita. The WaveCatcher Story Most GMT watches are concerned with places like London, Tokyo, Rome or Sydney. Who cares? Want to know what time it is at Pipeline in Hawaii? Cloudbreak in Fiji? Maverick’s in California? Now we're talking. WaveCatcher was built around a simple idea: wouldn't it be more fun if your GMT watch tracked the places you'd actually rather be? Maybe you're headed there. Maybe you've already been. Or maybe you're sitting at your desk wondering what the morning looks like at Cloudbreak while someone nearby is talking about quarterly projections. That's okay too. One glance at the WaveCatcher and you're somewhere else. Blue Lagoon The Blue Lagoon dial is the bright, tropical side of WaveCatcher. Its bold coastal colors take inspiration from sun-faded surfboards, clear blue water and the kind of beach day that makes you seriously question why you're indoors. It's colorful, upbeat and intentionally a little less serious. Exactly the way a surf watch should be. Like every WaveCatcher, Blue Lagoon was designed around our love of vintage watches, surf culture and the idea that a watch can remind you of where you've been, where you're going—or where you'd rather be. And this isn't just a colorful dial wrapped around a generic watch. WaveCatcher was custom-built from the ground up around a rock-solid automatic GMT movement , with sapphire crystal, sapphire bezel insert, 200 meters of water resistance and a stainless-steel case that's perfectly comfortable getting wet. Busy in the office and wondering what time it is at Supertubes? Not a problem. Out to dinner and looking for an excuse to say, “It's 7:00 AM at Pipeline. I should be doing dawn patrol right now” ? Even better. You don't have to surf to wear a WaveCatcher. Feel free to use the lingo anyway. At your own risk. We won't judge. Laid-back, colorful and always searching for the next adventure, WaveCatcher is for anyone who loves the beach, surf culture, vintage style—or simply the idea that somewhere in the world, the waves are probably better than whatever you're doing right now. Strap it on. Check the tide. Live life on Wave Time.
